ei.title: Chapter 4-12 3번: The Role of a Leader in Team Disagreements
ei.subject: 올림포스독해의기본1

fullPassage: Project leaders should not be surprised when disagreements emerge within the team. In fact, they should expect them. If they remain hidden, the leader may even want to seek them out for at least two reasons. First, different views can bring with them good ideas about the project and how it might be run. Although snap decisions about project changes should be avoided, leaders should be open to new and better ways to run the project. Second, when conflicting viewpoints are found, they are more easily resolved earlier rather than later in the project. Although team members may disagree about one or another aspect of the project, most simply want their ideas considered and resolved. The team tends to look to the project leader to play the lead role in resolving differences, and members will generally defer to the leader if they believe their views have been given due consideration.

questions.passage: Project leaders should not be (A)[surprised / delighted] when disagreements emerge within the team. In fact, they should (B)[expect / ignore] them. If they remain (C)[visible / hidden], the leader may even want to seek them out for at least two reasons. First, different views can bring with them good ideas about the project and how it might be run. Although snap decisions about project changes should be avoided, leaders should be open to new and better ways to run the project. Second, when conflicting viewpoints are found, they are more easily resolved earlier rather than later in the project. Although team members may disagree about one or another aspect of the project, most simply want their ideas considered and resolved. The team tends to look to the project leader to play the lead role in resolving differences, and members will generally defer to the leader if they believe their views have been given due consideration.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 프로젝트 리더는 놀라서는(surprised) 안 되고, 예상해야(expect) 하며, 숨겨져(hidden) 있다면 찾아내야 한다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① delighted — expect — hidden (A 반대: 놀란→기뻐하는)
❌ ② surprised — ignore — hidden (B 반대: 예상하다→무시하다)
✅ ③ surprised — expect — hidden — 원문 일치 ←정답
❌ ④ surprised — expect — visible (C 반대: 숨겨진→보이는)

questions.passage: Project leaders should not be surprised when disagreements emerge within the team. In fact, they should expect them. If they remain hidden, the leader may even want to seek them out for at least two reasons. First, different views can bring with them good ideas about the project and how it might be run. Although snap decisions about project changes should be (A)[encouraged / avoided], leaders should be (B)[open / resistant] to new and better ways to run the project. Second, when (C)[conflicting / harmonious] viewpoints are found, they are more easily resolved earlier rather than later in the project. Although team members may disagree about one or another aspect of the project, most simply want their ideas considered and resolved. The team tends to look to the project leader to play the lead role in resolving differences, and members will generally defer to the leader if they believe their views have been given due consideration.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 성급한 결정은 피해야(avoided) 하고, 리더는 열려(open) 있어야 하며, 상충하는(conflicting) 관점이 발견되면 해결해야 한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① avoided — open — conflicting — 원문 일치 ←정답
❌ ② encouraged — open — conflicting (A 반대: 피하다→장려하다)
❌ ③ avoided — resistant — conflicting (B 반대: 열린→저항하는)
❌ ④ avoided — open — harmonious (C 반대: 상충하는→조화로운)
det.tip: avoided(피해야 할) ↔ encouraged(장려해야 할), open(열린) ↔ resistant(저항하는)

Second, when conflicting viewpoints are found, they are more easily (A)[resolved / created] earlier rather than later in the project. Although team members may disagree about one or another aspect of the project, most simply want their ideas (B)[dismissed / considered] and resolved. ❌ ① resolved — dismissed — defer (B 반대: 고려→무시)
❌ ② created — considered — defer (A 반대: 해결→생성)
❌ ③ resolved — considered — object (C 반대: 따르다→반대하다)
✅ ④ resolved — considered — defer — 원문 일치 ←정답

det.korean: '거부하다(reject)'가 아니라 '예상하다(expect)'가 문맥상 적절하다. 리더는 의견 불일치를 예상해야 한다.

① surprised — 놀란, 원문 일치
② reject — 원문은 expect(예상하다) ←정답
③ hidden — 숨겨진, 원문 일치
④ seek — 찾다, 원문 일치

③ promoted — 원문은 avoided(피해야 하는) ←정답

det.korean: 팀원들은 자신의 견해가 충분한 고려(due consideration)를 받았다고 생각하면 리더에게 따른다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① strict punishment — 엄격한 처벌 (문맥과 반대)
❌ ② immediate action — 즉각적인 조치 (의견 고려와 무관)
❌ ③ personal benefit — 개인적 이익 (의견 존중과 무관)
✅ ④ due consideration — 충분한 고려 ←정답
det.tip: given due consideration = 충분한 고려를 받다

questions.passage: Project leaders should not be surprised when disagreements emerge within the team. In fact, they should expect them. If they remain hidden, the leader may even want to seek them out for at least two reasons. First, different views can bring with them good ideas about the project and how it might be run. Although snap decisions about project changes should be avoided, leaders should be open to __________. Second, when conflicting viewpoints are found, they are more easily resolved earlier rather than later in the project. Although team members may disagree about one or another aspect of the project, most simply want their ideas considered and resolved. The team tends to look to the project leader to play the lead role in resolving differences, and members will generally defer to the leader if they believe their views have been given due consideration.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 성급한 결정은 피해야 하지만, 리더는 프로젝트를 운영하는 새롭고 더 나은 방법(new and better ways to run the project)에 열려 있어야 한다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① strict deadlines for each team member — 문맥과 무관, 열린 태도와 모순
✅ ② new and better ways to run the project — 원문 일치 ←정답
❌ ③ immediate solutions to every problem — snap decisions를 피하라는 맥락과 충돌
❌ ④ detailed reports from all departments — 문맥과 무관
det.tip: be open to new and better ways = 새롭고 더 나은 방법에 열려 있다

ch: strict deadlines for each team member
new and better ways to run the project
